Application of the analytical method to pharmaceutical gel In order to test the method on commercial product, the absolute recoveries of adapalene and benzoyl peroxide from commercial gel (Epiduo) containing 0.1% adapalene and 2.5% benzoyl peroxide was determined. The recoveries of adapalene and benzoyl peroxide were 93.11±0.78% and 95.17±1.02%, respectively, that fall within limits of the USP monograph. Conclusion The RSM was successfully to optimize the composition of mobile phase.
